# Liora Head Spa

> Liora Head Spa is Albuquerque's premier luxury head spa, offering Japanese-inspired scalp treatments, scalp facials, and deep scalp detox rituals. Every treatment is customized to the guest's specific scalp and hair needs.

## Location & Contact
- Address: 8000 Paseo del Norte Blvd NE, Suite C9, Albuquerque, NM 87122
- Phone: (505) 238-5806
- Email: hello@lioraheadspa.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/lioraheadspa
- Booking: https://lioraheadspa.com/#contact

## Hours
- Wednesday-Saturday: 10am-7pm
- Sunday: 10am-5pm
- Monday-Tuesday: Closed

## Services & Pricing
- Signature Ritual (60 min) - $130 - the foundation ritual: consultation, scalp assessment, dry massage, warm oil therapy, double cleanse, conditioning mask, extended scalp massage
- Illumination Ritual (75 min) - $140 - extended version of the Signature Ritual with deeper massage; now includes hot stone massage and foot & calf massage
- Liora Luminary Ritual (90 min) - $170 - Illumination Ritual plus a Signature Mini Facial (oil cleanse, custom mask, sculpting facial massage, Cryo therapy, Lymphatic Stimulation Therapy)
- Renewal Growth Ritual (90 min) - $199 - growth-focused elixirs, high-frequency comb therapy, red-light LED therapy for thinning, shedding, or compromised scalp health
- The Liora Reset Blowout - $80 - dry scalp massage, double cleanse, conditioning mask, and a full round brush blowout
- Crown Glow Facial (add-on, 30 min) - +$40 - proprietary oil cleanse, custom facial mask, sculpting facial massage, Cryo therapy & Lymphatic Stimulation Therapy; can be added to any ritual
- Enhancements (add-ons): Extensions Handling +$25, Extra-Long/Dense Hair +$15, Hard Water Detox +$20, Blonde Brightening +$20, Repair & Strengthening +$20, Scalp Wellness Crystal Treatment +$20, No-Iron Style/Blow Out +$30

## Membership
- Liora Ritual Membership: $95/month (regularly $110) - one 60-minute Signature Ritual per month, priority booking, 10% off enhancements and products, exclusive seasonal offerings, birthday-month upgrade to the Illumination Ritual, one-month rollover if unused

## Current Promotions
- The Together Promo (always available): book any service for two, second ritual is 50% off
- The Midweek Reset (always available): 20% off every Signature Ritual on Wednesdays and Thursdays
- Seasonal specials rotate monthly - see https://lioraheadspa.com/#promotions for what's currently running

## About
Liora means "my light" or "I have light." Every treatment is designed to restore balance, encourage circulation, and nurture natural radiance through intentional touch and genuine human connection, flowing from scalp to soul.

## Policies
- No deposit required at booking
- Cancellations or no-shows within 24 hours of the appointment are charged 50% of the service price
- All hair types, textures, and lengths are welcome
- Guests are asked to arrive 15-20 minutes early
